message: This BAM is not aligned to a reference genome, so TRUST4 cannot use it. Its reference sequences look like: AACTCAGCAATGAAAC-1_contig_1, AACTCCCAGGCTAGGT-1_contig_1, AACTCCCAGGCTAGGT-1_contig_2. TRUST4 needs a genome-aligned BAM whose references are chromosomes (chr1, chr2, chr14, …), because it finds V(D)J reads by genomic coordinate. Cell Ranger's all_contig.bam is aligned to the assembled contigs, not the genome, so it cannot be used here — upload possorted_genome_bam.bam (or an equivalent genome alignment) instead. If all you have is all_contig.bam, use the Cell Ranger VDJ workflow with all

TRUST4 could not assemble this BAM using its CB/UB tags: TRUST4 completed but produced no assembled contigs (trust4_annot.fa is missing or empty).. The run was stopped instead of retrying without barcodes, because a barcode-free assembly cannot be assigned to cells. If the BAM does carry CB/UB tags, try the "Extract reads with samtools first" option, which copies the tags into TRUST4's FASTQ path.
None of the 198 reads carried a CB tag, so no read could be assigned to a cell. This BAM does not look like 10x output.
